## What changes, for whom

## How it was made

- Coding agent that helped (if any):
- [ ] I ran `npm run check` and, for screen changes, `npm run e2e` locally, and I can answer questions about this change

## Checklist

- [ ] New behaviour has a test (invented names only)
- [ ] Texts go through Lingui, with the German translation
- [ ] Module or connector: manifest in `modules/<name>/module.ts`, listed in `modules/index.ts`, row in `docs/modules.md`, contract tests pass
- [ ] Sport: file in `sports/`, listed in `sports/index.ts`
- [ ] Schema change as a new migration (`migrations/README.md`), safe for every club
- [ ] Personal data: nothing new, or documented in the module's `privacy()` and in `docs/privacy.md`
